# Ironvale Manufacturing - foundry-api

foundry-api runs the plate inspection pipeline: inspection submits from the line cameras,
plate lookups from the dispatch desk, and plate registration from the intake stations.

logs/foundry-api.log is the service log for 2026-05-08, written in time order. Access lines
carry the outcome of one request:

    <UTC timestamp> <status> <method> <path> dur_ms=<handler milliseconds>

Configuration and worker lifecycle events are interleaved as plain INFO lines, and the
inspection queue reports its backlog as WARN lines. A 503 status marks a submit the
inspection workers could not accept.
files.docs/foundry-runbook.md:
# foundry-api runbook

- The inspection queue drains in FIFO order; workers are recycled when a submit exceeds
  the four second handler budget.
- Backlog WARN lines are advisory: they are written when the queue depth crosses the soft
  threshold, and they do not mean the request was refused.
- Raise the queue depth alert with the plant-platform rota before restarting workers;
  restarts drop in-flight inspection frames and the line must re-shoot the plate.
- Plate lookup answers come from the dispatch desk terminals and are read-only.
